title: Multimodal open d1 decision models for the edge
key_facts: Liquid AI released two open-weight decision models: d1-3B, and d1-omni-600M, which is experimental.
Decision models produce no tokens; they answer in a single forward pass.
d1-3B scores a mean of 82.9 across seven public datasets, above a rival called Decider 4B; d1-omni-600M scores 78.4, above Decider 2B at 77.1.
d1-3B keeps the vision ability of its LFM2.5-VL-3B backbone; the release reports no vision or audio benchmarks.
On Nvidia hardware (GeForce RTX 4090, Jetson AGX Thor, Jetson AGX Orin 64 GB, Jetson Orin Nano), d1-3B answers in under 50 ms on every device tested.
On GPU, d1-3B answers a question in under 10 ms and processes a 384px image in under 18 ms.
quote_evidence: Unlike our generative models, decision models don’t produce tokens but answer in a single forward pass.
d1-3B achieves a mean score of 82.9, the highest in the table and above Decider 4B.

why_it_matters_hint: Developers who need fast, small models for classification and checks get open options, with speed figures from the company.
notes: Read from the Hugging Face blog (2,138 chars). Speed and score figures are Liquid AI's; d1-omni-600M is an early research release.
